name: Care For Your Body
overview: Scripture reveals that our bodies are created in the image of God, fearfully and wonderfully made, deserving of reverence and care (Genesis 1:27; Psalms 139:14). Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is an act of spiritual worship (Romans 12:1). While Jesus teaches not to be anxious about bodily needs (Luke 12:22), the renewal of the mind leads to discerning and living according to God's perfect will, which includes honoring the body He has given (Romans 12:2). Ultimately, care for the body is grounded in the profound love God has shown through Christ, who offers eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16).
